title: French in India: Pondicherry, Andhra battles, Circars

boxes.title: Northern Circars: 1753-1788
head: Year
Event
rows: Grant paid for **Bussy's** troops; peak of French influence
After ==**Chendurthi**==, Salabat Jang switched to the British
British got **Machilipatnam, Nizampatnam, Vakal Mannar**, part of **Kondapalli**
French power north of Krishna ended, except **Guntur**

boxes.title: Andhra & Carnatic: added detail
items: Ambur: Muzaffar Jang → Subedar, Chanda Sahib → Nawab
Treaty of Pondicherry: no meddling in princes' quarrels
Godeheu recalled at start of **Third Carnatic War**

boxes.title: Company & settlements: more
items: French = ==third Europeans in Andhra==; Yanam in Godavari delta
Martin was director at **Masulipatnam**; Sher Khan Lodi = Bijapur governor of **Valikondapuram**
Martin died **31 Dec 1706**; Pondicherry = French HQ in India
